title: Encoding and wire: share-link tokens and layer-state params on the globe; Gray codes, GEIS tokens, the 32-bit bridge header and the 41-byte claim in the bridge
shape: GEV serialises a view into a URL hash. The bridge serialises a measurement into Gray bands and a claim into 41 bytes. Both have a version field; only one has a checksum.
flow: view {lat, lon, alt, heading, pitch, style, layers} ──sharelink──▶ #hash   (GEV; version, no checksum)
16 layer ids ──LAYER_STATE_REGISTRY──▶ single letters   a f m s e w ...
measurement ──Gray bands──▶ payload_bits ──bridge_protocol header (magic, ver, modality, len) + XOR
av-enc-1: view ──Gray bands──▶ cb_relay script ──voice──▶ decode ──▶ share link   (a noisy channel)
av-enc-3: 'dN_quakes/dt within band' as a .claims line with fail=['feed_state != nominal']
'flir' on the wire names a sensor the app does not have

notes.bottleneck: A share link has no checksum and fails open; a bridge frame has one and fails closed. Do not unify them; document why they differ.
notes.leverage: The .claims line format (80 tokens) is the cheapest way to make a GEV feed claim readable by every repo in the ecosystem.
notes.harmonics: Gray banding is irrelevant on a URL bar and decisive on a voice channel; av-enc-1 is where the bridge's rule 3 earns its keep in GEV.
notes.tertiary: Every wire token is a claim. 'flir' claims a sensor.

gev.role: hash format: lat, lon, alt, heading, pitch, style token, bloom, hud, detection, map; STYLE_TO_URL maps thermal -> 'flir'
clampScopeTerminusPct: a bounded scalar on the wire

bridge.role: BinaryBridgeEncoder: from_geometry()/to_binary(), Gray bands so adjacent values differ in one bit
bijective 7-bit token codec, all four operators (GIES-4/8)
32-bit header: magic, version nibble, modality nibble, 16-bit length; XOR trailer
.claims line format and 41-byte binary claim via CLAIM_TABLE.json
33-byte wire that is lossy while documented exact (GLY-5): the failure to not repeat
payload_bits per domain; vortex is variable-width and says so

ecosystem.why: shape/family/entity semantics; the layer registry is a family table
src/geometric_encoder.py was ported from this repo; a third token surface to keep aligned
octahedral glyph consumer of the encoding
a verifiable codec is a library entry

avenues.title: A view as a Primitive over a voice-only channel
avenues.moves: camera {lat, lon, alt, heading, pitch} + layer tokens -> Gray bands -> cb_relay_format script; the receiver decodes to a share link. Banding matters here because the channel is a human voice on a noisy radio, not a URL bar
avenues.fails_if: banded altitude (say 8 bands over 100 m..20,000 km) does not reproduce the framing; then the band count is the finding and it is a number, not a design

avenues.title: Layer tokens and the modality nibble in one table
avenues.moves: LAYER_STATE_REGISTRY (16 letters) and bridge_protocol's 8 modalities side by side with version and checksum columns; a table, so the collision stage (repo_guard stage 4) can see two names for one thing
avenues.fails_if: there is no mapping worth having because a GEV layer is a source and a bridge modality is a physics; the table then documents that they do not correspond, which is still the useful output

avenues.title: GEV feed claims in .claims line format
avenues.moves: 'dN_quakes/dt within band under bounds(global, 24h, M2.5+)' as a .claims line with meas=['usgs all_day'] and fail=['feed_state != nominal']; 80 tokens instead of 600
avenues.fails_if: CLAIM_SCHEMA's cycle enum has no value for a polled feed; then the enum is short one class and that is a schema change, not an adapter

avenues.title: Share-link round-trip as a lossless-ness test
avenues.moves: encodeLayerStateParams -> decode -> encode must be identity (repo rule 4, applied to GEV); GEV has unit tests, this names the property
avenues.fails_if: float rounding in the hash makes a second encode differ; then the link is lossy and the created-at param is doing the work of a version, which it is not

interference: 'flir' on the wire names a sensor the app does not have; see 02-atmosphere-storm. A token is a claim
The bridge header has a checksum and the share link does not; a mangled link fails open to defaults, a mangled bridge frame fails closed. Different channels, different correct answers
